SPEAKER_SETUP_INTRO: To add or change a speaker, put it in pairing mode, find it, then select it below.
DISCOVERY_INTRO: Search to add a speaker or see the current state of known speakers. Pairing mode is needed only for a new speaker.
CHOOSE_SPEAKER_NOTE: Choose the speaker you want, then select Use selected speaker. Other connected audio speakers will disconnect but stay paired. Music remains on the default output until you separately choose Play on Bluetooth speaker. Unidentified devices may be speakers that have not exposed their audio profile yet.
FIND_ANOTHER_NOTE: Your current speaker remains saved unless another speaker connects successfully.
RESET_SPEAKER_SETUP_NOTE: Returns to the default audio output and clears this plugin's saved-speaker setup. System Bluetooth pairings are preserved for other plugins.
FIND_SPEAKERS_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Keep the speaker nearby and in pairing mode.
AUDIO_DESTINATION_NOTE: Audio routing is manual. If the Bluetooth speaker is turned off or disconnects, choose Play on default audio output yourself; there is no automatic fallback. With Mixer Type set to Hardware, Bluetooth is effectively sent at 100%. Choose Software to control Bluetooth volume from Volumio.
SWITCH_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching stops playback. Press Play when the change completes; the current track restarts from the beginning.
SAVED_SPEAKER_NOTE: Reconnect or disconnect the selected device, remove its system pairing, or clear only this plugin's setup.
FORGET_SPEAKER_NOTE: Choose any paired audio device, even if it is switched off or disconnected. Forget removes its system Bluetooth pairing. If it is the active device, music returns to the default output. Pairing mode will be required to add it again. Other paired devices are not affected.
AUTO_RECONNECT_NOTE: Reconnects the saved speaker when it becomes available, but never changes the selected audio destination and does not provide automatic fallback.
PREFERRED_CODEC_NOTE: Saved separately for each Bluetooth audio device, including speakers, headphones and earbuds. Automatic chooses the best mutually available codec in this order: LDAC, aptX HD, AAC, aptX, then SBC. A manual choice is verified and never silently falls back. With Software mixer active, the current Volumio volume is preserved while routing changes.
SCAN_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Audio-capable devices are listed first when BlueZ reports their profile.
VOLUME_NOTE: Software is safest initially. Speaker hardware volume may not follow Volumio volume.
CREATE_OUTPUT_NOTE: Available only when device diagnostics confirm BlueALSA. This never installs a competing audio stack or edits MPD directly.
MANUAL_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching output stops playback. Press Play when the switch completes. Default output returns to the device already selected in Playback Options.
